scope: Car, Train 88, Excavator and Mechanical Mother trial only
problem: When the expected artifact is a complete vehicle, machine or assembly in the original workbench, truthful part-level work, a static image, a local test or HTTP success can be useful internal evidence but cannot satisfy the whole-machine delivery contract.

sourceCorrection.title: 整机交付工作方式.md
sourceCorrection.contract: The whole artifact must be visible, rotatable, selectable and adjustable, published to the original workbench, with missing or untested items explicit. Observation-ready and fully accepted are distinct states.

currentBestView.covered: R2 already binds expectedArtifact and target fidelity, while the reference and freshness gates block creative substitution and stale delivery.
currentBestView.gap: No applicable regression case was found that makes a faithful part-level candidate fail when the expected artifact is the complete machine, or that distinguishes whole-machine observation-ready from full acceptance.

boundedQuestion: When expectedArtifact is the complete machine in the original workbench, what minimum receipt distinguishes valid whole-machine observation-ready delivery from part-level progress, static or HTTP evidence, and overclaimed full acceptance?
falsifiableHypothesis: A receipt requiring exact artifact identity, complete-machine kind, visible/rotatable/selectable/adjustable capabilities, publication to the original workbench, explicit known gaps and separated acceptance layers rejects partial, static, HTTP-only, disconnected and overclaimed candidates while allowing an honestly labeled observation-ready whole machine.

controls: observation-ready whole machine with an explicit deferred gap
full acceptance only when all acceptance layers pass
not published to the original workbench
observation-ready candidate overclaimed as fully accepted

activation.rollbackPoint: Remove this Candidate if one real affected Mother trial shows no discrimination beyond existing R2 receipts; do not modify R2 or production gates before that trial.

limits: The synthetic replay does not prove any current car, train, excavator or mechanical production artifact is observation-ready.
Capability booleans require real verifier evidence; producer declarations alone are insufficient.
Observation-ready intentionally permits declared deferred detail gaps and is not user acceptance.

routing.target: Car, Train 88, Excavator and Mechanical Mother owners
